seo.body: The estimator reads the same published prices as the pricing page. Your project type and complexity select a published range; brand, content and delivery pace adjust it. What a form cannot judge is settled in scope review, and only the written proposal is binding.

sections.title: What scope review settles
sections.body: Some costs depend on details a form cannot judge. You can tick them in the estimator; they are confirmed with you before the proposal is written and do not move the range on screen.

sections.title: What the estimate does not include
sections.body: The range covers the build itself. Other costs appear as separate lines, so nothing is folded into the total.
points: VAT, added at contract stage
Domain, hosting and business email — each on its own line
Paid third-party tools and channels, such as SMS, if your build uses them
A maintenance plan, billed monthly or yearly

sections.title: From estimate to proposal
sections.body: After scope review you receive one written proposal with the agreed scope and one binding figure. Any later change to scope is documented and agreed in writing before the work starts.
points: One written figure, valid for a fixed period
Three payments: to start, at a development milestone, before launch
Code, designs and accounts pass to you at final payment
Additions priced from the same published ranges

faq.a1: No. The range appears on screen as you answer, and no contact details are needed to see it. Your details are only asked for when you request the written proposal with the binding figure.
faq.a2: It is indicative, not a quotation. The range is read from the same published prices as the pricing page. The binding figure is set in a written proposal after we review the scope with you.
faq.a3: Every build includes a {warrantyDays}-day warranty: defects in delivered work are fixed at no charge. Ongoing maintenance is a separate plan, billed monthly or yearly, only if you choose one.
faq.a4: We review your answers and scope notes with you, then send one written proposal. You can download this estimate as a PDF once the request is sent.
faq.q1: Do I need a call to see an estimate?
faq.more: Payment terms, ownership and published prices are on the pricing page.
faq.q4: What happens after I request a proposal?
faq.subtitle: Questions about the cost estimate
faq.title: Estimate questions
faq.q5: Why is it a range and not one price?
faq.a5: A form cannot judge everything that sets the cost. Your answers place the build inside a published range. Integrations, content, sign-in and performance targets are confirmed with you in scope review, and the proposal then fixes one figure.
faq.q6: Does the estimate include VAT, hosting or a domain?
faq.a6: No. The range covers the build itself and excludes VAT at {vatRate}%. Domain, hosting and business email appear as separate lines, and paid third-party services are billed only if your build uses them.
